text: Esther fell and is in the hospital overnight; Nadia is covering the shop's overnight shift alone for the first time.
A standing order of twelve milk loaves for the Halloran wake is due for pickup at six.
The walk-in proofer's thermostat is old and drifts warm; Esther nurses it by hand.
The milk loaf is Esther's slow overnight recipe; Nadia has only ever made it under Esther's eye.
